rationale: Response SHAPES are derived from the Eventbrite Platform REST API v3 (apiary.io spec, last updated 2024-02-16) documented example payloads: every paginated list endpoint returns a per-resource collection array (events/attendees/orders/...) alongside a `pagination` object carrying continuation/has_more_items/page_number/page_count/page_size/object_count; single-record GETs (User, Organizer, Media) return the object directly with no envelope; the error envelope is the documented { error, error_description, status_code } triple. All VALUES are synthetic / PII-scrubbed test data, not captured real responses. No live Eventbrite API was hit to produce these (verdicts.json: achievedCeiling=format-verified-no-creds, mode=unauthenticated).

piiSafety.emails: example+N@example.com (RFC 2606 reserved domain) — covers attendee profile.email + order buyer email
piiSafety.barcodes: 0000000000001 placeholder (real attendee barcodes are PII and access-controlled)
piiSafety.customAnswers: <redacted> — attendee/order custom question answers are free-text PII
piiSafety.ids: well-formed but synthetic numeric-string ids (needed for FK/PK + watermark verification)

sources.URL: https://www.eventbrite.com/platform/api (Eventbrite Platform API v3, apiary.io spec 2024-02-16)
sources.UsedFor: per-resource list envelope shape (events/attendees/orders/...), `pagination` continuation-cursor object (has_more_items + continuation + page_number/page_count/page_size/object_count), Bearer auth scheme, changed_since incremental param on Attendee/Order, error envelope { error, error_description, status_code }, per-operation write paths + wrapped create bodies

edgeCasesCovered: list envelope with pagination.has_more_items=true + continuation cursor (multi-page)
single-record GET (User/Organizer/Media — object returned directly, no envelope)
create-response (POST → body.id) for every write-capable family
delete-response for every family declaring DELETE
record carrying a `changed` ISO-8601 watermark (Order/Attendee incremental)
